external_validation_gate.reason: The BacMet experimentally confirmed release is protein FASTA with UniProt accessions. A DNABERT nucleotide challenge set requires a separately audited protein-to-CDS mapping. BacMet-derived references have also contributed to MEGARes, so BacMet should be used as an interpretable annotation layer rather than claimed as independent model validation.
external_validation_gate.next_use: Use BacMet gene, compound, and QAC annotations beside exploratory pharmaceutical-water genome scores. Add a reviewed UniProt-to-CDS mapping only if nucleotide-level annotation or enrichment analysis is needed.
